head.title: Pix Adventures – Learn by playing
head.description: A gamified platform to learn coding from age 6

hero.subtitle_long: With fun courses, gamified challenges, and characters guiding the journey, kids become digital creators!
hero.title: Learn coding by playing
hero.subtitle: Interactive adventures for kids aged 6+

how.subtitle_long: In Pix Adventures, learning to code is fun, guided, and personalized.

1.title: 1. Choose a course
1.text: Adventures tailored to your child’s age and level. Each course begins with a captivating story.

2.title: 2. Learn by playing
2.text: Complete missions and challenges in interactive worlds while learning coding step by step.

3.title: 3. Track progress
3.text: Parents and educators can follow progress, achievements, and receive personalized suggestions.

pricing.section_subtitle: Plans designed for learning through play at home
